description: Resolves Basenames (name.base.eth, on Base) and ENS names (name.eth, on Ethereum) to wallet addresses, including a Base-specific address and profile records (avatar, description, url, X, GitHub). Or give an 0x address to get its primary name, verified by resolving the name back to the same address. A bare name like jesse means jesse.base.eth. Useful before sending funds to a name or labeling counterparties. Read-only. Not charged for invalid or unregistered names. Paid via x402; see list_prices.

name.description: A name (jesse.base.eth, vitalik.eth, or just jesse) or an 0x address.

name: name_lookup
title: Basename and ENS lookup: name to address, or address to its verified primary name
